title: Finally, after paper trading 31,000 strategies for 8+ months, the best 3 will go on to trade real money in 2 weeks!
author: Mr_Hodlerr

replies.author: Mr_Hodlerr
replies.body: Survival of the best AI, basically 31k AI agents each trading with the best strategy they thought of.

replies.author: MendozaHolmes
replies.body: how do 20k of these supposed ai agents not just build the same strategy

replies.author: Mr_Hodlerr
replies.body: When an agent had a strategy it had to publish its intermediate representation of the strategy and if it matched an existing agent's who is already trading it then it was rejected and the agent had to think of new one till it had no existing match.

replies.body: That number is big because lot of the backtests fail (when out of sample or cross coin results output a weaker or negative edge). They don't even make it to the live paper trading.

replies.body: That’s a fair point that most strategies fail before paper trading. It still counts toward the trial total, so the 31,000 (or the full number of backtests before it) is the number to use when judging whether the survivors are luck.

comments.body: 31k strategies down to three is serious filtering. The next test is whether the edge survives real fees and slippage and moon showing the cost upfront is a good reminder to keep that math honest. Two weeks is when the real sample starts.

replies.author: Mr_Hodlerr
replies.body: Paper trading included fees and slippage. But you are right real market is real. I will post the edge divergence on real trade vs paper trades as it trades with real money.

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Paper-trading 31,000 strategies and promoting the best three is a selection process, so the question is how many of those best three would be expected by luck alone. Choosing the winners on the same paper period you then show makes the numbers look better than they’ll be live, so I’d define the promotion rule in advance, track the three from the day they’re picked as a separate forward record, and report their results next to the median and the best-of-31,000 by chance. In the screenshot, the 133 trades since January and a drawdown of 8.7% vs 46.5% for buy and hold is a good start. For the BTC and ETH cycle itself, Cymetica’s Crypto Outlook (simulated price-range scenarios) is one way to stress-test ranges.
